_comment: DEP-2 evidence register (authored 2026-11-28 from sources actually inspected). Classes E1-E5 per the DEP-2 brief. 'acquired' entries are verified by SHA-256 in data/external/dep2_sources/ACQUISITION_LOG.json. Nothing here is upgraded because it is useful; statuses are what the material supports.

entries.source_name: GCC City Disaster Management Plan 2026 - 'Depth of Inundation During Monsoon - 2021' tables (pp. 93-107)
entries.publication_date: 2026 edition (exact date not printed on the pages read)
entries.spatial_resolution_or_accuracy: street / locality name + ward; geolocated by third-party gazetteer (street polygon, place, or locality centre); 52% of 2021 records placed
entries.data_format: PDF table (official) + CSV extraction + GeoJSON placement
entries.download_url: https://github.com/reclaimchennai/chennai-monsoon-map/releases/download/sources/cdmp_2026.pdf (mirror of the GCC PDF; GCC original URL not confirmed)
entries.licence: Government publication; licence not stated. Used for derived statistics; PDF not redistributed in the package
entries.verification_status: Depth classes re-verified against the PDF row by row; third-party extraction found to shift depth columns (corrected). Placement precision recorded per record.
entries.independence: Independent of the project's Sentinel-1 products (administrative list)
entries.limitations: Year-level timing only; list of known inundation spots, not an extent; selection/reporting completeness unknown; absence of a record is NOT absence of flooding; 48% of 2021 records could not be placed
entries.intended_use: Presence-only reported-location comparison (2021 only); ward-level recurrence

entries.source_name: GCC CDMP 2026 - 'Depth of Inundation During Monsoon - 2015' tables (pp. 63-75)
entries.verification_status: Depth classes re-verified against the PDF; the 3-5 ft 'High' column was missing in the third-party extraction (72+ rows) and is restored
entries.limitations: Year-level; list not extent; the 2024 CDMP edition lists 511 locations for 2015 vs 306 in the 2026 edition (editions differ; 2026 used, 2024 kept as cross-check)

entries.source_name: Crowd-sourced flooded streets, Chennai Flood Map (osm-in/flood-map) - dump '11AM Dec 2, 2015'
entries.observation_date: cumulative public reports up to 2015-12-02 ~11:00 IST (repo README); lower bound uncertain (Chennai map promoted from ~2015-11-20 per repo history)
entries.spatial_resolution_or_accuracy: OSM street segments flagged by the public; segment-level, no per-report timestamp or depth
entries.spatial_coverage: Chennai city and suburbs (where contributors reported)
entries.licence: Code MIT; geometry derived from OpenStreetMap (ODbL 1.0) - attribution required
entries.verification_status: File and timestamp verified from repository history; individual reports NOT verifiable (anonymous)
entries.independence: Independent of Sentinel-1 and of the GCC list
entries.limitations: Anonymous crowd reports; spatial bias towards contributors; cumulative over an unknown window ending 2 Dec; 'not flagged' is not 'not flooded'
entries.intended_use: Second 2015 reported-location set; cross-source consistency with EV-2015-01

entries.verification_status: Snapshot time not verifiable beyond the file name
entries.limitations: Mixes pre- and post-1 Dec reports; cannot be matched to a single S1 date

entries.source_name: UNITAR-UNOSAT 'Flood waters over Chennai area' (imagery 1 Sep, 14 Oct, 12 Nov 2015; second version adds 24 Nov 2015)
entries.acquisition_status: NOT ACQUIRED - host blocked from the agent workspace (HTTP 000); downloadable by the owner
entries.verification_status: metadata read from the BTAA catalogue record only
entries.independence: Satellite-derived (Sentinel-1/Landsat per map legend); NOT independent of Sentinel-1 when compared with S1 products; UNOSAT states it was not field-validated
entries.limitations: Predates the 1-2 Dec peak; 'possible saturated wet soils' class
entries.intended_use: If acquired: 2015 satellite-derived extent for consistency comparison with 12/24 Nov S1 (not independent validation)

entries.source_name: NRSC 2015 Chennai flood inundation zone (KML, via OpenCity 'Chennai Floods 2015 Data')
entries.licence: OpenCity lists Public Domain (original NRSC licence not confirmed)
entries.acquisition_status: NOT ACQUIRED - host blocked from the agent workspace
entries.intended_use: Highest-priority owner download: potential E1/E4 2015 extent

entries.source_name: OpenCity: GCC water-stagnation locations 2015, crowd-sourced flooding locations 2015, SDSS flood hotspots, 'Chennai flooding points in 2015'
entries.limitations: Hotspots may be planning designations, not observations

entries.source_name: IWMI flood maps: 24 Nov 2015 (Sentinel-1) and 9 Dec 2015 (ALOS-2 PALSAR-2)
entries.acquisition_status: NOT ACQUIRED (PDF; host blocked for binary download)
entries.verification_status: map legend read via search snippet only
entries.limitations: PDF map: georeferencing/digitising would create DERIVED evidence

entries.source_name: Dartmouth Flood Observatory event 4309 'Maximum flood extent, 2015 flooding in southern India'
entries.limitations: Coarse for a 30 m urban grid; maximum over 7 weeks

entries.source_name: NRSC Disaster Event 15-FL-2021-TN inundation PDFs (Cartosat-2E MX 13 Nov 2021 vs 7 Feb 2021) for parts of Chennai Corporation and Ambattur taluk
entries.spatial_resolution_or_accuracy: PDF map; Cartosat-2E MX ~2 m native
entries.spatial_coverage: parts of Chennai city and Ambattur
entries.acquisition_status: NOT ACQUIRED here (host blocked); known to Agent 1
entries.limitations: No machine-readable vectors; cloud obscuration noted on the map; 3 days before / after the nearest S1 dates (16 Nov)
entries.intended_use: Best candidate for derived digitising (labelled DERIVED) around 16 Nov S1
entries.evidence_class: E3 (map, qualitative) -> potential E1-derived if georeferenced

entries.source_name: Care Earth Trust crowd-sourced Chennai flood map (Nov 2021, >250 localities)
entries.observation_date: Nov 2021 (form asked date of peak flooding)
entries.acquisition_status: NOT ACQUIRED - no downloadable dataset found
entries.limitations: Data not public as a file
entries.intended_use: Request data from Care Earth (owner action) - would add dated 2021 reports

entries.source_name: Project S1PE bright-VV components per date (2021-11-04, 11-16, 11-28; +5 dB primary threshold)
entries.observation_date: Sentinel-1A descending, rel. orbit 92, ~00:31 UTC = 06:01 IST on each date
entries.spatial_resolution_or_accuracy: 30 m master grid; components summarised as centroid + area
entries.data_format: CSV component table with UTM centroids
entries.verification_status: grid origin reproduced exactly from 33,543 single-cell components
entries.independence: IS Sentinel-1: cannot validate anything Sentinel-1-derived
entries.limitations: Bright VV is NOT floodwater (urban double-bounce, artefacts, wet surfaces); exploratory diagnostic
entries.intended_use: Exploratory comparison with EV-2021-01 locations against a null model

entries.source_name: IMD bulletins / press releases: depression crossed north TN coast close to Chennai 17:30-18:30 IST 11 Nov 2021; 21 cm Nungambakkam 08:30 IST 6 Nov - 08:30 IST 7 Nov
entries.limitations: Rainfall is not flood ground truth

entries.source_name: 1 Dec 2015 extreme rainfall (494 mm max station, 08:30 IST 1 Dec - 08:30 IST 2 Dec) and Chembarambakkam releases
entries.original_publisher: IMD (via WWA/CDKN science summary; TN Govt press release 13 Dec 2015)
